Lina: Quick postmortem follow-up (INC-2026-128). We agreed to an alert-tuning sprint: noise pruning, thresholds, dedupe/suppression rules, and paging routing changes. Dropping owners and a minimal runbook here so we can track PRs and rollout windows.
RunbookBot: Incident INC-2026-128 archived at 2026-04-28T04:12:22Z. Postmortem link: /incidents/INC-2026-128.
Omar: I'll own the suppression/dedupe work. Plan: run a 21-day dry-run to produce suppression candidates + false-suppression matrix. ETA: Tue EOD.
Gita: I'll take thresholds and the canary dashboard (24h). Need p95/p99 + week-over-week spikes for `inference.latency_ms` and `api.error_rate`. Will post SQL + graphs tomorrow AM.
Lina: Paging/rota owner? We want to reduce overnight wakeups. Proposal: create `night-low` route 23:30-06:30 and move low-action alerts there; add a 10m coalesce window for repeaters. Also exclude CI namespaces from paging.
Omar: Draft suppression rule (dry-run):
```
# suppress repeated worker timeout from same host
if count(error: "worker_timeout", host) > 12/min then suppress for 35m
```
Omar: I'll run dry-run and post results here. Goal: keep false-suppression < 2%.
Gita: Threshold plan:
- compute rolling 30d p95/p99 and spike ratio for relevant metrics
- propose new thresholds where p99 > 1.8x baseline OR sudden spike > 3x baseline
I'll attach tables + graphs by 09:30 PT.
Lina: Owners so far: dedupe/suppression = Omar, thresholds + canary = Gita, paging = Lina, PM = Lina. Target: PRs open by 2026-05-05; rolling changes the week of 2026-05-12. Tag PRs `pm-followup/INC-2026-128`.
Gita: I'm also prototyping a recurrence detector to flag monthly or weekly noisy signals. Simple heuristic: alerts with >5 occurrences in 30d AND pattern_score > 0.6 flagged as recurring. Will post prototype output as CSV.
Omar: If the recurrence detector flags something, I'll exclude it from suppression candidates and route it to engineering backlog with a recommended severity.
Lina: Sequence: 1) Gita: recurrence analysis + threshold candidates (tomorrow 09:30 PT) 2) Omar: dedupe dry-run + PR (Tue EOD) 3) Lina: paging config + canary route (Fri) 4) Lina: consolidate rollout + rollback runbook (by next Mon).
Gita: Adding rollback automation idea: if alert volume increases >12% in the 24h post-change, automatically revert route/threshold changes. I'll add the canary metric and alert for rollback.
Omar: Draft PR (WIP): https://github.com/redwood-inference/observability/pull/700 (dry-run artifacts to follow).
Lina: Please include a short runbook snippet in each PR: steps to pause the change, verify system health, and who to page. Use label `postmortem/INC-2026-128`.
OpsLead: Small operational note  make sure the suppression rules log suppressed-alerts to a separate stream so we can audit and rehydrate if needed. Otherwise we risk stealth-silencing.
Omar: Good call. I'll add suppressed-alerts -> `alerts.suppressed.audit` with metadata (rule_id, window, example_trace).
Gita: One blocker: I need access to archived traces (prod-traces-90d) for the recurrence prototype. Filed infra request: ITR-2219.
Lina: Thanks. If infra perms are slow, call it out and we'll reassign or provide a short-term snapshot.
Omar: Dry-run note: naive suppression would have affected ~11 alerts/day on our sample, false-suppression estimate ~1.4% (sampled traces). Posting detailed CSV to the draft PR shortly.
Gita: SQL + charts posted: https://github.com/redwood-inference/observability/pull/701 (WIP). Proposed threshold table attached.
Lina: React with :white_check_mark: when PRs are up so I can update the follow-up tracker. I'll schedule a 20m rollout-check 24h after the first change is live.
OpsLead: Also add a checklist item: run a one-hour manual verification after canary passes (check latency, error rates, and user-facing traces).
Gita: :white_check_mark: recurrence analysis posted (CSV) and attached to PR description.
Omar: :white_check_mark: draft suppression PR created, will add dry-run logs by EOD.
Lina: Thanks team. If anyone hits blockers (data perms, runbook gaps), flag here and we'll reassign. RunbookBot: Reminder scheduled: followup-sync (INC-2026-128) on 2026-05-13T16:00:00Z.
